Kerala Inspired Prawns Pulao
leftover rice | easy recipe | high protein | dinner for two | easy dinner | date night 

SAVE this recipe to make soon and FOLLOW @ellasrecipebook_ for more :) 

Nutrition Information: 
C: 48  F: 9 | P: 30
Calories: 416 per serve
Serves 2

Ingredients
1 tbsp oil ( coconut works well, but use what you have ) ( 15 grams ) 
1 tbsp mustard seeds 
2 tbsp minced garlic 
2 - 3 green chillies, chopped 
2-3 sprigs curry leaves 
250 grams shrimp marinated in red chilli powder, haldi, coriander powder, pepper and lemon juice 
salt + black pepper, to taste
 2 cups cooked rice ( 1 cup rice ie 140 grams ) ( ive used sona masoori,  you can use basmati rice ) 

pro tip: the prawns are super tasty without adding the rice too if you trying to keep it low carb :) 
you can replace prawn with paneer and it’ll still taste amazing :) 

please note: between you and me i would never call 90% of the food i make authentic because india is so diverse and so is each state hence i use the word inspired quite literally :)
